Name: Grapes of Ferngill
Author: StunkyMcDoo123
Description:
Greetings wine lovers.

The purpose of this mod is to bring some variety to the Vineyard experience of Stardew Valley. It does so by adding 9 new grape varieties and editing the in-game grapes to match the new balance levels. It also adds 5 new artisan goods and 2 new artisan machines. These grapes are not based on real life grapes (I HIGHLY recommend the mod Stardew Vineyard for that) but have been made to fit into the world of Stardew Valley. 

[b]**VERSION 5.0**[/b]
Finally, the mod has been moved over to Content Patcher for everything. A HUUUGGEE thanks to BeepBoop07 for this. They have done a marvellous job of updating and have my sincerest thanks. The effort they have put in outstanding, and their commitment to compatibility is wonderful. Thank you B.


[b]**STARDEW 1.6 UPDATE -- VERSION 4.0.0**[/b]
And its done. All updated. We now use Content Patcher rather than Json Assets, and Custom Bushes rather than Crop Growth Adjustment.
Bear in mind, the grape starters now act like Tea Bushes. You can plant them anywhere (Farm, Greenhouse, Ginger Island etc), they don't need Tilled Soil and they don't need Watering. They wont die out of season and they have unique Fall and Winter crop sprites. To offset this, Grape Starters are rather expensive.
I have built in the compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded, which means no additional download needed. The SVE content will automatically unlock if you have SVE installed. We also have compatibility with Heaps at Ridgeside Village. Check there often as you may get lucky and get access to some of the new grape starters early. 

[b]***INTER-MOD-COMPATABILITY***[/b]
A number of changes and fixes here from previous versions. Importantly, I have split out the PFM file so each compatibility option has its own file. I now offer compatibility files for the following mods

[b]**NEW**[/b]
-- Cornucopia: Artisan Machines -- Grape Wine can be made in the Vinegar Cask.
-- Wildflour Atelier Goods -- All compatibilities listed below have been updated to the latest version.
-- Stardew Valley Expanded -- All goods are now affected by the [spoiler] Marrying Sophia wine price increase [/spoiler]
-- Bush or Crop -- For those that prefer the vanilla behaviour of grape bushes, they can now be toggled between cop behaviour and bush behavior

[b]**RETAINED**[/b]
-- Cornucopia: More Crops -- White Grapes now make the GOF products (Except Sparkling Wine, which still produces their Sparkling Wine, but using the GOF recipe.)
-- Visit Mt Vapius -- White Grapes and Sun Grapes now make the GOF products (If you use both Cornucopia and Visit Mt Vapius, the Cornucopia White Grapes recipes are used to retain their Sparkling Wine)
-- Copper Still -- Brandy can be made from thew GOF wines, and a new product Grappa can be made using GOF grapes.
-- Atelier Wildflour Confectioner (Sweet) -- GOF grapes can be used to make Grape Candy
-- Atelier Wildflour Confectioner (Frozen) -- GOF grapes can be used to make Grape Popsicles
-- Atelier Wildflour Barista (Cold) -- GOF Grapes can be used to make Grape Juice.
If you don't use any of these mods, feel free to either ignore the SMAPI warning that it couldn't load the module, or delete the relevant PFM folder. Once  Stardew Vineyard updates I'll update the compatibility with that too. If there's anything that you might feel needs some compatibility, let me know!

[b]***WHATS IN THE MOD***[/b]
What can you find here.
﻿* 10 new Grape varieties, along with their Starters and Raisins.
﻿* A mail and shipping based quest system to unlock the different Grapes and Products.
﻿* Several new Artisan goods, including "Grape Seed Oil" (Put some Grapes in the Oil Maker), "Wine Vinegar" (Pop some wine in the Preserves Cask/Cornucopia Vinegar Jar) and ﻿Yeast, along with a new Artisan Machine, the "Yeast Starter".
﻿﻿* Some of the new Grape varieties and goods are sold from various locations, be sure to shop around.
﻿* Fully integrated Gift Tastes. Everyone has an opinion on GOF products, including an ever increasing array of Modded NPCs. Listed below
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿* New Artisan Machine, the "Hardwood Keg", Recipe sold by Robin. This can be used to make the Grape Wine varieties shown below.[center]

For those who want the whole process spoiled, or those stuck on how to progress, please see this spoiler.
[spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Grow or Forage Common Grapes
[*]Sell 10x Common Grapes
[*]JOJA takes notice and starts selling JOJA brand grapes
[*]Sell 15x Common Grapes
[*]Letter from Tamina, Pierre starts selling Gallant Grove and Sunset Blush Grape Starters (ONLY in Spring and Summer)
[*]Sell 5x Common Grape Wine
[*]Letter from Tamina, explains Hardwood Kegs (Robin sells the Recipe for these from the Start)
[*]Sell 15x Grape Wine
[*]Letter from Tamina, teaches you the Yeast Starter recipe. (Pierre sells Yeast from the Start)
[*]Sell 10x Sparkling Grape Wine
[*]Letter from Tamina, explains Sweet Wines
[*]10 Spring Y2, letter from Tamina requesting you sell Deep Envy, Golden Aura, Passion Rouge and Rosy Riot grapes
[*]Travelling Merchant starts selling Deep Envy, Golden Aura, Passion Rouge and Rosy Riot grapes
[*]Sell 10x each of Deep Envy, Golden Aura, Passion Rouge and Rosy Riot grapes
[*]Letter from Tamina, provides you with Lunatone Grapes
[*]1 Summer Y2, letter from Tamina, explains Ocean Mist Grapes
[*]Ship 5 Ocean Mist Grapes (Forageable on Ginger Island). 5 heart friendship with Willy, get letter from Willy. Teaches you how to make Ocean Mist Starters. Must have had letter about Ocean Mist grapes first
[*]5 Fall Y2, letter from Tamina requesting you sell Titania Grapes. Must have had Lunatone Grapes mail first
[*]Sell 5 Titania Grapes
[*]Letter from Tamina, provides you with Ancient Grapes
[/list][/spoiler]
